versions.content: During reception of a static length (Secured / Authentic / Cryptographic) I - PDU, i.e. EcuC Parameter DynamicLength (ECUC_EcuC_00078) is set to FALSE, by means of a lower layer bus interface and when SecOC_RxIndication has been called, the SecOC module shal l silently discard this I - PDU in case of the received length is smaller than the configured length.
